title: Why Sanitary Tees Fail on Horizontal Drains
description: Using a sanitary tee on a horizontal-to-horizontal drainage branch is one of the most common installation mistakes in residential plumbing. Sanitary tees are designed primarily for vertical-to-horizontal transitions or vent lines. When installed on horizontal runs, the sweep of a sanitary tee is too short to direct waste smoothly, causing solids to settle and lead to frequent drain clogs. Plumbing codes require a wye fitting or a combination wye and eighth bend for horizontal branch connections to maintain proper flow velocity, smooth direction change, and long-term reliability.
